items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: See, when we had this band here, we were living on Wyatt Street, you see?

ctx.x: Well, I got his address at home. I got the address at home. I think I got that address at home. See, when we had this band here, we were living on Wyatt Street, you see? But now he don't live there no more now. He moved from there, you see? Oh yeah. Uh huh, yeah, he moved from there. I always can get that address from there, you see? Yeah, we all got that. Yeah, he moved from there, you see? There's a couple of other questions.
One about, did you play valve trombone one time?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: see another boy he was manager of the band, Fais. Because he had the band before I came here, you see? So after this boy died, he sent for me, see for the, for coming to play with his band.

ctx.x: Thomas Valentine. You have any middle name? No middle name. When did they start calling you the kid? Where did that come in?

When I came down here. Just down? When I came down here. The bass player gave me that name. T.G. Rouchon. Bass player. Oh yeah. See they was going to pick, you know when we organized the band, they was going to see what name would match, you know what I mean, for the band. You know what I mean? So T.G. Rouchon said well my name would be the best. See? So that's why they named the band after me. After me. So then after that well, see another boy he was manager of the band, Fais. Because he had the band before I…

See? We might start in just a little bit at the beginning. Give the very first facts about your life. The date that you were born. I think we have that, but just to be sure we have it all down. Uh huh. Yeah. Where were you born?

ctx.x: Yeah. T. Rouch, or no, no, I mean not him. Bikes. And that boy would do Rodney, that boy plays. He was playing. Then I had with the chorus playing, you know, he play with Fat Domino now.
